reason: The README clearly describes an agent plugin for generating, editing, compositing, and understanding images through configurable external APIs, with results saved to the workspace.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供通过外部图像服务生成、编辑、合成和理解图片的能力，并将生成结果保存到工作区。
summaries.en: Provides an agent with image generation, editing, compositing, and image-understanding capabilities through configurable external services, saving generated results to the workspace.

capabilities: Generates, edits, and composites images through configurable external image services
Analyzes image content and extracts text or visual descriptions
Writes generated image results to workspace files
Uses a user-configured API key for external service access
